facts.activity_file: working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions

control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
positive communication before approaching mobile equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: unrelieved potential energy found after isolation of HT-9003

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on HT-9003 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment on HT-9003 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating in reduced visibility, specifically working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions. HT-9003 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during routine operation while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 4 May 2024 a high potential incident was recorded on HT-9003 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during routine operation; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
